compounding_issues: Session 1 committed the entire node_modules tree (~3100 files) with no .gitignore, bloating every subsequent commit — session 2's diff still carries tracked node_modules changes
The seed codebase (a NestJS-like auth API in index.ts) was unrelated to the static-site-gen target and was fully discarded in the greenfield session, contributing nothing to the final product

Two parallel templating systems coexist: the string-based pageTemplate/indexTemplate in src/template.ts are retained as a fallback alongside the new Handlebars engine, doubling the maintenance surface
The story stopped after 2 of 5 planned sessions — the feature_addition arc ends mid-flight with no theme/plugin/advanced session to round out the template engine
key_decisions: Greenfield discard of the mismatched auth-API seed in favor of a modular TypeScript layout (src/build.ts, src/template.ts, src/types.ts) with a commander CLI

Session 2's backward-compatible Handlebars template engine: layouts + partials + per-page frontmatter template/layout selection, gracefully falling back to the built-in string templates when no templates dir exists
Extending PageMeta with template/layout fields and exposing a --templates CLI flag rather than changing the existing build() contract
Test-driven discipline: the test suite grew from 15 to 27 tests across sessions, and each session ran jest until green and tsc --noEmit clean before committing
story_review.trajectory_description: The arc improved steadily. Session 1 (greenfield) replaced the discarded seed with a clean, well-tested modular SSG core — build pipeline, string templating, CLI, and a 15-test suite. Session 2 (feature_addition) layered a proper Handlebars template engine with layouts, partials, and frontmatter-driven template selection on top without breaking any existing tests, added 12 new tests, and recovered from two initial test failures (raw markdown leaking instead of rendered HTML into the {{body}} slot) before committing. Each session self-verified with passing jest runs and clean tsc; the only flat note is that the string-template fallback path was kept even after the engine superseded it, leaving deliberate redundancy. The story ends with all 27 tests green and the product notably more capable than it started.
story_review.summary: Two tightly coherent sessions built a minimal static-site generator and then extended it with a robust, backward-compatible Handlebars templating layer, marred only by committing node_modules and an unrelated seed that was thrown away.
